subject: Initial SIG intake from BlueCove Capital — owners & timeline proposal
messages:
From: BlueCove Capital <security@bluecove.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG request for BlueCove — initial intake

Jordan —

Thanks for taking this. Attached is our SIG spreadsheet that we use for vendor assessments (column mapping is on tab 1). We need a first-pass owners mapping and an estimated delivery date for the evidence requested. Target timeline for our compliance board is Nov 20, so if we can get owners and an initial evidence drop by Nov 12 that would be ideal.

Key asks:
- Quick map of which Redwood team owns each SIG section (we can accept provisional owners for now)
- A short list of the artifacts you can produce in the first cut (e.g., network diagram, access control policy, incident response runbook)
- Any blockers (3rd-party dependencies, sensitive redactions)

Attachments: SIG_2026_11_bluecove.xlsx

Thanks — please loop in whoever owns security/compliance at Redwood.

— Laura H.
BlueCove Capital | Senior Procurement Analyst
procurement@bluecove.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example, dev_patel@redwood.example, priya_natarajan@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@bluecove.com
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request for BlueCove — owners & timeline proposal

Thanks Laura — looping the minimal team to triage and provide owners.

Marissa, Dev, Priya — BlueCove sent the SIG spreadsheet (attached to Laura's email). They want a first-pass owners mapping + an evidence drop by Nov 12 if possible. My suggested split for an initial pass (please confirm by EOD Mon Nov 9):

- Governance / Legal / Privacy: Jordan Blake (I'll cover privacy statements, data processing addendum, and infra-level policies)
- Infrastructure & Network: Marissa Cole (network/topology, datacenter controls, encryption in transit)
- Access Management / Identity: Dev Patel (IAM screenshots, onboarding/offboarding SSO process, least privilege controls)
- Data Protection / Encryption at rest: Priya Natarajan (KMS config, key rotation, backup retention)

Please respond with: commit (yes/no), any known evidence gaps, and 1-2 quick notes on where the artifacts live (Drive link or doc path). I created a working folder for evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_shared_sig and put a simple evidence_manifest_template.csv in there.

Action items I will own: consolidate owners into BlueCove's SIG template, produce an "evidence manifest" CSV listing items we can deliver by Nov 12, and coordinate a follow-up call if they need walkthroughs.

Marissa/Dev/Priya — can you confirm owners and call out any items you cannot share due to vendor contracts or redaction needs?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Infrastructure Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.example>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example>, marissa_cole@redwood.example, priya_natarajan@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@bluecove.com
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request for BlueCove — owners & timeline proposal

Confirmed — I can own Access Management / Identity (including IAM policies and SSO).

Notes / evidence I will gather by Nov 12:
- IAM role inventory export (sanitized) — will place in Drive (filename: iam_inventory_20261112.csv)
- SSO configuration doc with screenshots (redact tenant IDs as needed)
- Samples of onboarding/offboarding runbook (internal SOP) — will provide a redacted version if there is any PII

Potential blockers: service account credential screenshots may need redaction; if BlueCove requires raw secret values we will not provide them, but we can provide policy screenshots and rotation schedules. Also FYI: some IAM logs older than 90 days are archived; if they request older logs we may need to request retrieval from archive (adds 3 business days).

I'll upload the above artifacts to the shared folder and update the evidence_manifest_template.csv with the expected delivery dates.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example>
To: BlueCove Capital <security@bluecove.com>, procurement@bluecove.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, dev_patel@redwood.example, priya_natarajan@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request for BlueCove — owners & timeline proposal

Laura / BlueCove team — thanks for the request and quick timeline. Per internal responses above, here's our consolidated intake and plan: 

Owners (provisional):
- Governance / Privacy / Legal: Jordan Blake (I'll attach the DPA and privacy statement)
- Infra & Network: Marissa Cole (network diagram v2 attached)
- Access Management / Identity: Dev Patel (IAM exports, SSO config)
- Data Protection / Encryption at rest: Priya Natarajan (KMS docs & backup policy)

Attachments included: evidence_manifest_template.csv (filled with initial inventory), network_diagram_v2.pdf

What we will deliver by Nov 12: initial evidence bundle (redacted where necessary) and the owners mapping inserted into your SIG spreadsheet. Anything requiring contract-level redaction or archived log retrieval will be flagged in the manifest with an estimated ETA.

Next steps:
1) BlueCove to confirm Nov 12 evidence drop is acceptable or provide an alternate milestone.
2) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough the week of Nov 15 to walk through anything you consider high risk.
3) We'll maintain the evidence folder and update HubSpot record HSP-987654 with progress.

Laura — please let us know if you prefer canned redactions (we can apply a standard template) or need a live session to review sensitive artifacts.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Infrastructure Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.csv, network_diagram_v2.pdf
